finding: When agent-factory.counterRemote lives in the global git config, a move pushes C to origin and then fails on `git config --unset` (exit 5). The move then ends with a Python traceback and exit 1, and the setting stays. A second move resumes, finds C on origin, and fails on the same unset at next-id:867. The fix: catch CalledProcessError of each unset, report the move as done, and tell the User to remove the setting from the scope that `git config --show-origin --get agent-factory.counterRemote` names.
why_this_severity: VIRGIL writes the setting with `git config` into the repository config, where the unset works, and the counter on origin is right in every case (no to fails_purpose); a User who set the value globally gets a traceback after a successful move and must find the global value by hand (raises_cost).
